model.summary: Model favors KC by 14.5 points (89% win chance). Biggest factors: Quarterback rating (KC +4.7), Elo rating (KC +4.2), Scoring margin (last 8 games) (KC +2.7). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 45.8 total points (KC 30, ARI 16). Biggest factors: Wind x pass rate (lowers total 1.1), Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 0.9), Wind speed (lowers total 0.5). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.

qb_what_if.note: Approximate: swaps only the quarterback rating and the model's QB-change flag (a new starter counts as a change). Team offense and defense form stay as they are. A positive margin change favors the home team.
